Details: Develop a Comprehensive A/B Test Plan for a Fictional Feature
This task is part of Community Dreams Foundation (CDF) through the CDF Portal / TaskVerse.
TaskVerse volunteer task portal
Smart Task Match recommendation panel
Determine whether personalized task recommendations increase the rate at which eligible volunteers claim a task.

Increase task claim conversion rate from 12.0% to at least 13.8%, a 15% relative lift.

Users may ignore the panel or claim mismatched tasks. Mitigation: include match reasons and monitor unclaim rate.
Claims may increase while completions decrease. Mitigation: use completion rate and unclaim rate as guardrails.
Users may see inconsistent experiences. Mitigation: persist assignment at user level.
Results may not generalize. Mitigation: run for at least two full weeks.
Roll out if the primary metric improves, guardrails remain healthy, and no major usability issues appear.
Revise and retest if task detail views increase but task claims do not, or feedback suggests unclear recommendations.
Do not roll out if task claim conversion decreases, completion rate drops, unclaim rate increases beyond guardrails, or users report confusion.
Roll out to 25% for 3 days, then 50% for 3 days, then 100% if guardrails remain healthy. Continue monitoring for 14 days.
Check sample size, extend up to 21 days if needed, then review secondary metrics and qualitative feedback.
Keep the control experience, document learnings, review recommendation quality, and create a revised hypothesis before retesting.
